description.value: Elastic is a Dutch-American software company offering a platform for enterprise search, observability, and cybersecurity. Its products let users search and analyze large datasets, monitor system performance, and detect anomalies.
Elastic helps organizations get real value from their data, bringing AI models to customers' data on the open Elasticsearch foundation across Search, Observability, and Security.
Elastic builds the Elastic Stack and describes Elasticsearch as 'the search database for AI.'
Elastic is a Dutch-American software firm, formerly called Elasticsearch, that offers platforms for enterprise search, observability, and cybersecurity.
Elastic N.V. is an Amsterdam-founded, publicly traded search and AI software company.

product_description.value: Elasticsearch, the core search and analytics engine (Serverless, Hosted, or self-managed), with solutions for Search, Observability, and Security, plus Kibana, Elastic Agent Builder, AutoOps, Workflows, and Jina AI search models.

Three solutions: Search and AI (vector and hybrid search, reranking, RAG), Observability (logs, metrics, traces, APM, infrastructure and digital experience monitoring), and Security (SIEM, endpoint protection/XDR, security operations automation). Products include Elasticsearch, Kibana, Elastic Agent, Beats, Logstash, Elastic Agent Builder, AutoOps, Workflows, and Jina AI search models.
Elasticsearch, Kibana, Beats, and Logstash, which together form the Elastic Stack, plus Elastic Cloud (SaaS), Elastic Cloud Enterprise, and Search AI Lake for large data lakes.
The core is the Elasticsearch platform, which includes Kibana, Beats, and Logstash. Its three main solutions are Search & AI, Observability, and Security.

business_model_description.value: Revenue comes mainly from platform subscriptions, with resource-based pricing. Products are offered as hosted cloud services (Elastic Cloud Hosted and Serverless) and as self-managed software.
The article does not describe the business model directly. It indicates a software-licensing model with a SaaS offering (Elastic Cloud).

customer_description.value: Enterprises; IT departments, DevOps teams, and security operations centers are the targeted buyers. One profile claims over 50% of the Fortune 500 use it.
Named customers include Docusign, Sitecore, Comcast, Discover, UOL, and PepsiCo; the company says over 75% of the Fortune 100 rely on Elastic.
Named customers include Docusign, UOL, PepsiCo, GitHub, Wells Fargo, Dish, Siemens, and Visa; 75% of the Fortune 100 choose Elastic.
Elasticsearch technology is reported to be used by eBay, Wikipedia, Yelp, Uber, Lyft, Tinder, and Netflix.
